title: Jensen Huang says AI leaders calling for regulation don't want new legislation, but to be "relieved of the laws we do have" because of "ulterior reasons" (Truman Dickerson/Business Insider)
summary: Truman Dickerson / Business Insider: Jensen Huang says AI leaders calling for regulation don't want new legislation, but to be “relieved of the laws we do have” because of “ulterior reasons” — Don't let the black leather jacket fool you, Jensen Huang isn't a doomer. — Nvidia's CEO said as much in an interview with CBS News aired on Sunday.
contentText:
Truman Dickerson / Business Insider :

Jensen Huang says AI leaders calling for regulation don't want new legislation, but to be “relieved of the laws we do have” because of “ulterior reasons”   —  Don't let the black leather jacket fool you, Jensen Huang isn't a doomer.  —  Nvidia's CEO said as much in an interview with CBS News aired on Sunday.
